series.name: Geo Blitz
series.pitch: One geography question, answered on a real, honest map: equal-area for size claims, a scale bar for distances, disputed borders shown with who administers and who claims them.

series.name: Body & Brain
series.pitch: Anatomy and neuroscience questions answered on public-domain anatomical plates with animated call-outs and a counted number.

series.name: Sports Sprint
series.pitch: Records, rules and venues: bar races for records, procedural pitch/court diagrams, a timeline strip for firsts, and a map when the venue is the story.

series.name: Wild Files
series.pitch: Animal superlatives with honest scale comparisons and a range map (GBIF occurrence-derived, CC0/CC BY) instead of a stock clip.

series.name: Cosmic Quiz
series.pitch: Registered from the feed; not scheduled (needs a planet/scale engine pass before activation).

series.name: Time Vault
series.pitch: Registered from the feed; not scheduled (history questions can reuse the strip + map engines when activated).
